title: Unfulfilled Past Obligation: kellett volna + infinitive ('should have')

sections.title: Expressing What Should Have Been Done
sections.content: *Kellett volna* followed by an infinitive expresses an action that ought to have been done in the past, but was omitted: *Meg kellett volna kérdeznem.* ('I should have asked.'). When the subject is explicit, the infinitive takes inflected endings: *Időben el kellett volna indulnotok.* ('You [pl.] should have left on time.').

items.spanish: Sokkal hamarabb észre kellett volna vennünk a problémát.
items.english: We should have noticed the problem much sooner.

items.spanish: Nem lett volna szabad egyedül hagyni őt a nehéz helyzetben.
items.english: One shouldn't have left him alone in that difficult situation.
